Discover Sweden's cities — a map built by the people who live here

Stadsvandring.io is a free web app (PWA) where residents build the map of their own town. Explore 9774 sights, buildings, people and historic events across Mjölby, Ydre, Kinda, Mullsjö, Värnamo, Motala, Valdemarsvik, Boxholm, Ödeshög, Alingsås, Göteborg, Stockholm, Norrköping, Finspång, Gävle, Visby, Borgholm, Piteå, Varberg, Falkenberg, Marstrand, Karlskrona, Halmstad, Smögen, Västervik, Dalby, Kristianstad, Åtvidaberg, Helsingborg, Malmö, Skanör Falsterbo, Landskrona, Kalmar, Hässleholm, Lund, Åre, Eskilstuna, Uppsala, Vellinge, Luleå, Linköping, Örebro, Västerås, Jönköping, Växjö, Karlstad, Sundsvall, Umeå, Östersund, Nyköping, Vadstena, Sigtuna, Eksjö, Nora, Trosa, Vaxholm, Mariefred, Söderköping, Strängnäs, Enköping, Trelleborg, Karlshamn, Ronneby, Lidköping, Mariestad, Arboga, Falun, Gränna, Sala, Härnösand, Hjo, Askersund — and add the ones you are missing. Every contribution is reviewed by other people in the same town before it goes live.

No installation needed: Stadsvandring.io runs straight in your browser on phone and desktop, and you can switch between English and Swedish at any time inside the app. Below is an English overview of every place. The full place articles are written in Swedish — open the app and tap the flag to read them in English.

You can also join in: add a place, upload a photo or a story, comment on somewhere you know, and build your own route — a walk or a run past the places you like — then share it with a friend. It is free, and there is nothing to buy.

Walking tours

🚶 The Central WalkFrom the railway station through the heart of the old mill town — about 2 km. The station that turned a milling village into a railway junction, Stora Torget, the medieval church and the open-air heritage farm. 🚶 The Medieval RingIn the footsteps of the Folkunga dynasty around Skänninge & Bjälbo — churches, monastery ruins and rune stones from the 13th-century power centre of Östergötland.

Mjölby · 167 places

MjölbyLocality · An old mill village on the Svartån that became a railway hub and the regional centre of south-west Östergötland.
SvartånWaterway · The river whose rapids gave Mjölby its mills — and its very reason to exist.
Mjölby kyrkaChurch · The town church on the village's highest point, with a medieval tower that survived the great fire of 1771.
Mjölby järnvägsstationStation · The station that turned a mill village into a railway junction and regional hub.
Mjölby Stadshotell (gamla Järnvägshotellet)Hotel · A timber hotel opposite the station, built just after the railway arrived in 1873.
Stora TorgetSquare · The village's historic heart, by the old crossroads toward Småland.
Mjölby hembygdsgård (Norrgårdsholmen)Museum & heritage · Falu-red museum houses on an island in the river, with a fine marquetry collection.
Galleria KvarnenTrade & commerce · The town's shopping gallery, its name a nod to the milling heritage.
Gamla Stadshuset / Stadshuset i MjölbyBuilding · The town hall by the gallery and library; a Carl Milles sculpture stands at the entrance.
KvarnparkenCafé & restaurant · A riverside park and venue with a restaurant, pub and the statue of Skånska Lasse.
Konditori HörnetCafé & restaurant · A cosy, central classic patisserie next to the library.
Linds (bageri & konditori)Café & restaurant · Café and patisserie with its own bakery in Galleria Kvarnen.
Skånska Lasse (Theodor Lorentz Larsson)Person · Rural comedian and songwriter, a Mjölby resident for most of his life.
Statyn av Skånska LasseArt & statue · A statue in Kvarnparken of the town's beloved rural comedian.
Skånska Lasses husBuilding · The modest home where Skånska Lasse lived with his family.
Potatisrondellen (Mjölbypotäten)Art & statue · The town's most talked-about symbol: a giant King Edward potato in a roundabout.
Mjölby Intarsia / Fanerami ABIndustry & business · The marquetry firm that clad ocean liners and bank palaces in inlaid wood.
Ols Möbler (idag Mio Mjölby)Industry & business · A furniture dynasty founded in 1887 and still run by the same family.
Mjölby Bryggeri (historiskt)Industry & business · The town's old brewery, later focused on small-beer and soft drinks.
Mjölby UngdomsmusikkårMarching band · One of Sweden's foremost and largest youth wind orchestras.
Mjölby StadsmusikkårMarching band · A symphonic wind band with roots in the labour movement.
Carl Milles-skulptur (dansande figurer), StadshusetArt & statue · A sculpture by the world-famous Carl Milles outside the town hall.
Statyn 'Det kom en gång en mjölnare'Art & statue · A riverside sculpture honouring Mjölby's miller and milling heritage.
Bjälbo kyrkaChurch · The Folkung dynasty's manor church and Birger jarl's country — with a mighty medieval tower.
Birger jarl (Birger Magnusson)Person · The Folkung dynasty's most famous son, often counted as Stockholm's founder — born in Bjälbo.
Ingrid YlvaPerson · Birger jarl's legendary mother, linked to Bjälbo's church tower.
Högbystenen (Ög 81)Rune stone · One of Sweden's foremost runestones, second in Östergötland only to the Rök stone.
SkänningeLocality · One of Sweden's oldest towns and a medieval power centre, today part of Mjölby municipality.
Skänninge möte 1248Event · A church council that introduced priestly celibacy and strengthened the Church in Sweden.
Vårfrukyrkan ('Garpekyrkan'), SkänningeChurch · The German merchants' mighty brick church — one of few large medieval brick churches in Östergötland.
S:ta Ingrids klosterruinMonastery ruin · Sweden's first convent for women (Dominican).
S:t Olofs kloster & Petrus de DaciaMonastery ruin · The Dominican friary in Skänninge where 'Sweden's first author' worked.
Adolf Fredrik LindbladPerson · Composer born in Skänninge, 'the Swedish Schubert', teacher of Jenny Lind.
Lindbladsparken & bysten av A.F. LindbladArt & statue · A park in Skänninge with a bust of composer Adolf Fredrik Lindblad.
Ture Lång (Rolandsstaty), SkänningeArt & statue · A steel giant on Skänninge's square, a symbol of justice in the medieval German tradition.
Svaneholms borgruinCastle ruin · The ruins of a 14th-century castle on a headland in Lake Kilarpesjön.
Öjebro stenvalvsbroBridge · An old stone-arch bridge in the former mill village of Öjebro.
Stadsbranden 1771Event · The fire that almost wiped out the mill village — and lets us know its medieval layout today.
Dackefejden i Mjölby (1542–43)Event · Mjölby was the northernmost point reached by the Småland rebels of the Dacke War.
Mjölby AI FF / VifolkavallenSport · The town's football club, with its home ground at Vifolkavallen.
Fem blev en — Mjölby kommun (1971)Event · In 1971 the towns of Mjölby and Skänninge and three rural municipalities were merged into today’s Mjölby Municipality.
Mejeriet (Kanikegatan)Building · Mjölby’s old dairy on Kanikegatan, in operation from around 1900 to 1961 and later rebuilt as a community hall.

Stockholm · 640 places

StockholmLocality · Sweden's capital, built on fourteen islands where Lake Mälaren meets the Baltic Sea.
Stockholms slottCastle · One of Europe's largest royal palaces — the king's official residence in the Old Town.
Gamla stan & StortorgetSquare · Medieval lanes around Stortorget, the heart where Stockholm was once born.
StorkyrkanChurch · Stockholm's cathedral, where kings have been crowned and married since the Middle Ages.
VasamuseetMuseum & heritage · The only preserved 17th-century ship in the world — Sweden's most visited museum.
SkansenAttraction · The world's oldest open-air museum — Sweden in miniature, with a zoo.
Gröna LundAttraction · A classic waterfront funfair on Djurgården, and a major concert stage too.
NationalmuseumMuseum & heritage · Sweden's foremost art museum, by the water across from the palace.
Moderna MuseetMuseum & heritage · World-class modern art on the green island of Skeppsholmen.
Stockholms stadshusBuilding · The city's icon by Lake Mälaren, where the Nobel banquet is held in the Blue Hall.
Nobel Prize MuseumMuseum & heritage · The museum of the Nobel Prize and its laureates, right on Stortorget.
RiddarholmskyrkanChurch · A medieval abbey church and the burial church of Sweden's monarchs.
ABBA The MuseumMuseum & heritage · An interactive museum about the world's most famous pop group, on Djurgården.
FotografiskaMuseum & heritage · An international photography museum in an old customs house on the Stadsgården quay.
KungsträdgårdenSquare · The city's great meeting place — cherry blossom in spring, ice skating in winter.

Göteborg · 609 places

GöteborgLocality · Sweden's second city — the port on the Göta River, with canals, culture and west-coast wit.
LisebergAttraction · The Nordic region's most visited amusement park, a beloved institution since 1923.
UniverseumMuseum & heritage · A science centre with a rainforest, shark aquarium and space under one roof.
VärldskulturmuseetMuseum & heritage · A modern museum about people, cultures and the world's big questions.
Göteborgs konstmuseum & GötaplatsenMuseum & heritage · The city's art treasure at Götaplatsen, where Poseidon watches over the Avenue.
Göteborgs botaniska trädgårdNature reserve · One of Europe's largest botanical gardens, with glasshouses and wild nature.
SlottsskogenAttraction · The city's great park with animals, meadows and penguins — free and much loved.
Nya Älvsborgs fästningAttraction · A sea fortress on an island in the river mouth, reachable by boat in summer.
Skansen KronanAttraction · A crowned redoubt on a hill above Haga, with wide views over the city.
HagaAttraction · Gothenburg's oldest suburb — cobblestones, wooden houses and famous cinnamon buns.
FeskekôrkaBuilding · The fish hall that looks like a church — one of the city's best-loved landmarks.
MasthuggskyrkanChurch · A mighty brick church on the heights with one of the city's widest views.
TrädgårdsföreningenNature reserve · A classic 19th-century park by the Avenue, with one of Europe's finest palm houses.
Göteborgs södra skärgårdNature reserve · Car-free islands with rock bathing and fishing villages, a short ferry ride from town.

Norrköping · 169 places

NorrköpingLocality · The industrial city on the Motala ström, known for its unique industrial landscape.
IndustrilandskapetBuilding · Red brick factories along the rapids — one of Europe's most lavish industrial settings.
Arbetets museumMuseum & heritage · In the yellow 'Flat Iron' mid-rapids — about work and people's everyday lives.
Visualiseringscenter CMuseum & heritage · A science centre and 3D dome that takes you from inside the body to the universe.
Norrköpings konstmuseumMuseum & heritage · A strong collection of 20th-century Swedish art, founded by a tobacco manufacturer.
Kolmårdens djurparkAttraction · One of Europe's largest zoos, on the shore of Bråviken.
Löfstad slottCastle · A castle frozen in time — preserved just as it was when the last countess died in 1926.
Himmelstalunds hällristningarAttraction · Thousands of images carved into the rock by Bronze Age people.
Sankt Olai kyrkaChurch · The town's cathedral on Olai kyrkogata, a Baroque gem.
Carl Johans parkNature reserve · A city park famed for the ten thousand cacti in its summer planting.
ÖstgötateaternBuilding · Östergötland's great stage, with roots in one of the country's oldest theatre buildings.

Alingsås · 160 places

AlingsåsLocality · Sweden's 'café town', with wooden houses, cafés and a place in the story of the potato in Sweden.
Alingsås museumMuseum & heritage · The town museum, telling of Alströmer's manufacturing town and the history of the potato.
Nolhaga slottCastle · A white manor in a large park with a palm house, animal enclosures and walking paths.
Gräfsnäs slottsruinCastle · A romantic castle ruin in a park by Lake Anten.
Anten–Gräfsnäs JärnvägAttraction · A steaming heritage railway that runs along Lake Anten to the castle ruin.
Sjön MjörnWaterway · The large lake at the town's foot, with swimming, boating and islands.
Färgensjöarnas naturreservatNature reserve · A rift-valley landscape of clear lakes, cliffs and hiking trails.
Lights in AlingsåsEvent · International light art that turns the whole town into an exhibition each autumn.
Stora torgetSquare · The heart of the café town, lined with wooden houses and outdoor seating.
Christinae kyrkaChurch · The town's 17th-century church, named after Queen Christina.

ÖdeshögLocality · At Vättern's southern tip and the foot of Omberg — one of Sweden's richest areas for ancient remains.

Alvastra klosterruinMonastery ruin · The ruins of Sweden's first Cistercian monastery, founded in 1143 at the foot of Omberg.
OmbergNature reserve · The legend-wreathed mountain by Vättern, with sheer cliffs, beech woods and wide views.
TåkernNature reserve · One of Europe's foremost bird lakes — shallow, reed-rich and teeming with life.
Heda kyrkaChurch · One of Östergötland's best-preserved medieval churches, from the 13th century.
Ödeshögs kyrkaChurch · The parish church in the centre of Ödeshög.
HästholmenAttraction · An old harbour and loading place on Vättern, one of the lake's oldest.
Vättern vid ÖdeshögWaterway · Sweden's second-largest lake, clear as glass, along the area's western edge.

Motala · 85 places

MotalaLocality · Östergötland's lakeside town on Vättern — planned around the Göta Canal and once the radio voice of all Sweden.
Göta kanal genom MotalaWaterway · The canal's main town, where the locks sit in the centre and the white canal boats still glide by.
Baltzar von Platens gravPerson · The man behind the Göta Canal rests beside his own creation — he never lived to see it finished.
Charlottenborgs slottBuilding · A white manor by the Motala ström, ringed by one of the town's best-loved walking paths.
Sveriges RundradiomuseumMuseum & heritage · The story of how Motala became the voice that reached all of Sweden.
Motala MotormuseumMuseum & heritage · Gleaming cars, motorcycles and slices of 20th-century Sweden — down by the harbour.
VaramobadenBathing spot · One of northern Europe's largest inland beaches — soft sand along the edge of Vättern.
Motala VerkstadBuilding · The industrial works that built the Göta Canal — and laid the foundations of Swedish engineering.
Hålebergets naturreservatNature reserve · Steep rocky outcrops and pine forest a few miles north of town, with trails around the hill.
Bromossen naturreservatNature reserve · A vast mire in the forests between Motala, Borensberg and Godegård.
Motala kyrkaChurch · The town's grand 18th-century church — known for an unusually rich treasury of organs.

Ydre · 60 places

Norra Vi kyrkaChurch · The first Christian church in the village of Vi was probably a modest timber farm chapel, raised in the 12th or 13th century.
KorpbergetViewpoint · A hilltop with a lovely view over Norra Vi.
SkuruBuilding · A farmstead whose main house was built around 1880, the barn in 1937 and the old timbered storehouse during the 1800s.
Norra Vi vandringsledHiking trail · A marked hiking trail laid out by the Norra Vi heritage society, starting at the church and heading west.
YdreLocality · Östergötland's southernmost corner — lakes, deep forests and legends around Lake Sommen.
Urkons Håla, Norra ViAttraction · Where legend says the wild ur-cow kicked up the whole of Lake Sommen.
Bulegrottan, ÖstgötaledenAttraction · The giant Bule's cave — a cleft in the rock along the Östgötaleden trail south of Österbymo.
Asby-granen — Sveriges grövsta granAttraction · The thickest single-stemmed spruce in the country grows by Hedner's Park in Asby.
Kungabordet, Stora RödjeViewpoint · A viewpoint along the Östgötaleden trail with a royal picnic in its past.
Sunds Bruk, BulsjöånBuilding · An old ironworks site by the waters of the Bulsjöån, between Norra Vi and Sund.
Pukaberget utsiktsplats, TorpaViewpoint · High, wide and beautiful over Lake Raklången in Torpa parish.
Rocks Mosse naturreservatNature reserve · A mire with a boardwalk and lookout tower in north-eastern Norra Vi.
Nääs Gårdsbryggerigardsbutik · Award-winning farm craft where old farmstead history meets new ideas.
Torpöns naturreservatNature reserve · A blue-marked hiking trail around an island in the great Lake Sommen.
Högmåla knapp, Norra ViViewpoint · A lookout knoll over Norra Vi and Sommen — where warning beacons were once lit.
Svensbo lövskog, TorpönNature reserve · Old broadleaf forest on Torpön in Lake Sommen — one of the area's finest autumn walks.

Valdemarsvik · 44 places

ValdemarsvikLocality · The gateway to Östergötland's archipelago — a town at the end of a long sea inlet.
Harstena museumMuseum & heritage · An old fishing village out in the archipelago, with its school house and blubber-rendering hut preserved.
Kvädöfjärdens naturreservatNature reserve · Östergötland's first marine nature reserve — archipelago above and below the surface.
Gryts skärgårdNature reserve · Thousands upon thousands of islands, islets and skerries — Östergötland's outer archipelago.
Arnö naturreservatNature reserve · An island that shows how the archipelago looked at the turn of the last century.
Väggö naturreservatNature reserve · A quiet refuge that has long been vital to the archipelago's sea eagles.
Ämtö naturreservatNature reserve · One of Gryt's largest islands, shaped by people over centuries — oak meadows and trails.
Stjärnö naturreservatNature reserve · Islets and a peninsula in Kattedalsfjärden, close to Valdemarsvik's doorstep.
Torrö naturreservatNature reserve · Furthest south in Östergötland's archipelago — wind-bent pines and open sea.
Östgötaleden — skärgårdsetappernaHiking trail · Perhaps the finest stretch of the Östgötaleden runs along Valdemarsvik's archipelago coast.
Gusums brukBuilding · Preserved wooden buildings by the Gusumån recall a mill famed for brass, pins and hooks-and-eyes.

Finspång · 28 places

FinspångLocality · A mill town in Östergötland's 'Bergslag', with roots in cannons and copper.
Finspångs slottCastle · A magnificent stone mill palace, built on the wealth of cannon casting.
BruksparkenNature reserve · A green park at the heart of the works, along the water in the middle of town.
Rejmyre glasbrukBuilding · A venerable glassworks since 1810 — glass craft you can watch and try yourself.
Rejmyre kyrkaChurch · The works church in the glassmaking community of Rejmyre.
Sjön GlanWaterway · A large lake south of Finspång, with swimming, boating and fishing.
Risinge gamla kyrkaChurch · A medieval church with magnificent murals — 'Sankta Maria'.
Stjärnviks herrgårdCastle · A beautiful manor in the cultural landscape of the mill country.
Sjön TisnarenWaterway · A clear, island-strewn forest lake in the north, on the border with Södermanland.
Hällestads kyrkaChurch · A Bergslagen church in the western mining and forest country.
